1. <one sentence describing only the first photo's content>
2. <one sentence describing only the second photo's content>

note: Pairs 20-99 reproduce the replies used in the paper run byte-for-byte; pairs 0-19 were regenerated with the same pinned model, instruction and greedy decoding.
